name: George Mumford
bio: a Representative from North Carolina; born in Rowan County, N.C., birth date unknown; attended the common schools; member of the North Carolina state house of commons, 1810 and 1811; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Fifteenth Congress (March 4, 1817-December 31, 1818); died on December 31, 1818, in Washington, D.C.; interment in the Congressional Cemetery.
